description: Unsigned transaction burning the wallet's tokens of a settled series and taking what they pay: a call pays the stock's Borro vault shares, a put USDG (or the Steakhouse vault's shares with as_shares, for when the vault is short of free USDG). All the wallet holds unless shares is given.

as_shares.description: A put: take Steakhouse USDG vault shares instead of USDG

shares.description: Shares to claim (optional, default all), in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: claim_option
title: Prepare: claim a settled option
